build_r2d2_agent: build an R2D2 agent with an environment spec, Sonnet RNN network, and configurable replay buffer parameters
create_replay_table: create a Reverb prioritized replay table with FIFO removal and minimum size rate limiting for R2D2
configure_epsilon_greedy_policy: configure an epsilon-greedy policy network using trfl with a Sonnet DeepRNN wrapping the R2D2 network
run_recurrent_actor: run a RecurrentActor with the policy network and sequence adder to interact with the environment
update_checkpoints: update the R2D2 agent learner and save snapshots and checkpoints to disk
